syllabus.details: General Knowledge Mathematics General English Questions related to the relevant trade

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form provided with the recruitment notification.
Fill in the application form in English or Hindi.
Affix a recent self-attested colour photograph in the prescribed place.
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates.
Attach two recent passport-size colour photographs.
Enclose a self-addressed blank envelope with a Rs.50 postal stamp affixed.
Write the post name and category clearly on the application envelope.
Send the completed application through ordinary post to the prescribed address.
Ensure that the application reaches the authority by 3 November 2026.
important_instructions: The application must be sent through ordinary post only. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Applications without the prescribed photograph or self-attested documents will be rejected. Applications containing overwriting, cutting, corrections or incorrect information may be rejected. The self-addressed envelope with a Rs.50 postal stamp is compulsory. Government employees must apply through the proper channel and attach an NOC. Candidates must bring original documents and two sets of self-attested photocopies during document verification. Selected candidates may initially be posted at any unit under Coast Guard Region (West). Selected candidates will have all-India transfer liability. Candidates should regularly visit the Indian Coast Guard website for recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: Age Relaxation
content_sections.text: SC candidates applying against the reserved Engine Driver vacancy: five years OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates applying against reserved vacancies: three years Government servants applying for Store Keeper Grade II and Lascar: up to 40 years Other age relaxation will be provided according to Central Government instructions.

content_sections.heading: Indian Coast Guard Group C Salary
Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Indian Coast Guard Group C selection process will include the following stages: Scrutiny of applications Shortlisting of eligible candidates Document verification Biometric verification Written examination Trade test, where applicable Preparation of the final merit list Admit cards will be issued to shortlisted candidates for document verification and the written examination.

content_sections.heading: Written Examination Syllabus
content_sections.text: General Knowledge Mathematics General English Questions related to the relevant trade

content_sections.heading: Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: Candidates qualifying in the written examination will be shortlisted for the trade test wherever applicable. The merit list will be prepared according to marks obtained in the written examination.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents: Valid photo identity proof Matriculation marksheet and certificate Class 12, undergraduate, postgraduate or diploma certificates, as applicable Latest SC, ST, OBC or EWS certificate, where applicable Relevant experience certificates No Objection Certificate for candidates presently serving in a government organisation Two recent passport-size colour photographs Separate self-addressed blank envelope with a Rs.50 postal stamp affixed All documents must have been issued on or before the closing date of 3 November 2026. Original certificates should not be sent with the application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Indian Coast Guard Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form provided with the recruitment notification. Fill in the application form in English or Hindi. Affix a recent self-attested colour photograph in the prescribed place. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates. Attach two recent passport-size colour photographs. Enclose a self-addressed blank envelope with a Rs.50 postal stamp affixed. Write the post name and category clearly on the application envelope. Send the completed application through ordinary post to the prescribed address. Ensure that the application reaches the authority by 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Application Address
content_sections.text: Headquarters Coast Guard Region (West) Alexander Graham Bell Road PO Malabar Hill Mumbai - 400006

content_sections.heading: Envelope Superscription
content_sections.text: The envelope containing the application must be superscribed in bold letters as: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF __________” The candidate must also mention the applicable category, such as EWS, OBC Non-Creamy Layer, SC, ST or UR, on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application must be sent through ordinary post only. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Applications without the prescribed photograph or self-attested documents will be rejected. Applications containing overwriting, cutting, corrections or incorrect information may be rejected. The self-addressed envelope with a Rs.50 postal stamp is compulsory. Government employees must apply through the proper channel and attach an NOC. Candidates must bring original documents and two sets of self-attested photocopies during document verification. Selected candidates may initially be posted at any unit under Coast Guard Region (West). Selected candidates will have all-India transfer liability. Candidates should regularly visit the Indian Coast Guard website for recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under Indian Coast Guard Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of six Group C civilian vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Store Keeper Grade II, Engine Driver, Lascar, Civilian Motor Transport Driver, MTS Peon and MTS Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach the Indian Coast Guard by 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications offline through ordinary post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification?
faq.answer: The posts require Class 10 or Class 12 qualification with relevant professional certificates and experience, depending on the post.
